title: Reviews System
description: Customer feedback, review schemas, and endpoint details in Rozgar Connect

endpoints.description: Fetch all public reviews written for a specific worker. Results contain customer name and avatar details, along with rating and comment text.

body.workerId: Valid MongoDB ObjectId of the worker profile
body.comment: Non-empty text string containing review content

endpoints.headers: Requires Bearer Access Token in Authorization header
endpoints.description: Allows logged-in customers to submit feedback. Triggers average rating recalculation upon successful creation.

one_review_limit.explanation: Enforces that a single customer account can only leave a maximum of one review per worker. Any attempt to write a duplicate review results in a database duplicate key error.

review_visibility.public: All reviews and ratings are fully public. They can be read by anyone searching and viewing worker profile pages (no authentication required to view reviews).
